mathematical_sources.note: Official publisher PDF text directly consulted. Theorem 2.4, printed p.59, and Corollary 2.4.1, printed p.60, give paracompactness implies expandability; the finite-star proof is followed without a cardinal bound. Definitions and the normal-expandable implication in Theorem 1.1 on printed p.58 support the collectionwise-normal application. Prescribed-open containment and pairwise disjoint closures are explicitly derived strengthenings using normal shrinking, rather than a claim that the source states exactly these outputs. No formalization of the converse, cardinal-restricted theory, metrization applications, or later theorems in that paper is claimed.
mathematical_sources.title: On expanding locally finite collections, Canadian Journal of Mathematics 23(1) (1971), 58–68

related_formalizations.note: Uses canonical LocallyFinite, precise_refinement, locally finite closed unions, normal_exists_closure_subset and Mathlib’s paracompact R1 normality instance. Those are upstream infrastructure, not contributions of this package.

The earlier regular-space refinement criterion constructs an open expansion of a specific cover inside its proof. This package exports arbitrary-family finite-star expansion and discrete-closed-family closure separation, with canonical Mathlib imports only. No imports from earlier project packages and no novelty claim.
